notes: לָכֵן, יַעַן אֲשֶׁר and אֶל־בֵּין are each rendered by one English word and fuse under rule 30, headed on כֵּן, יַעַן and בֵּין respectively.
The suffix of אֲדֹנָי is unrepresented, the ASV writing only the Lord.
עֲבוֹתִים → the thick boughs is headed on boughs as in 31.3 and 31.14, with the competing head named.
